title: AI/ML Platform Engineer Roadmap
description: End-to-end roadmap for engineers building and operating the infrastructure behind production AI/ML systems: core ML foundations, LLM and RAG architecture, inference/training infrastructure at scale, platform engineering for AI workloads, observability for AI-native systems, and the evaluation and governance controls that keep models accountable in production.
